module: Flowgraph node "Rally Get Traffic Enabled" (category once_instant, tags rally and traffic). Indicates in trafficEnabled (bool) whether traffic must be enabled for the rally loop: rm:getTrafficEnabled() if available, otherwise true except for a dev mission (devMission) whose missionTypeData.devDisableTraffic is true.

workOnce.desc: Writes trafficEnabled from the loop manager, or the fallback value.
